a.lede: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.
a.title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit

b.lede: Nvidia founder and former CEO Jensen Huang stepped down last week amid several scandals, including an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.
b.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman says it’s ‘hard to imagine the AI industry without Jensen’
